title.narrative: Life-Saving Nutrition and Health Support for Communities Impacted by Food Insecurity in Maiduguri and Dikwa, Northeast Nigeria.

description.narrative: ltpgtltspangtTlt/spangtltspangthe proposed project addresses urgent health and nutrition needs in Dikwa and Maiduguri LGAs of Borno State, where prolonged conflict, displacement, and food insecurity have severely disrupted access to essential services. Led by INTERSOS, the intervention integrates health and nutrition approaches to improve outcomes for the affected population, with special attention to the most vulnerable groups.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspangtltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtHealth interventions will be delivered in Dikwa, supporting two PHC facilities and outreach sites to provide integrated services, including antenatal and postnatal care, skilled deliveries, outpatient consultations, mental health and psychosocial support, and clinical management for survivors of sexual violence. Preparedness and response to epidemics and disease outbreaks will be strengthened through community awareness campaigns, training of 20 community health volunteers and 10 rapid response team members, and timely referral and management of cases with severe complications.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtNutrition services will be provided in both Dikwa and Maiduguri. INTERSOS will scale up curative nutrition services, increasing bed capacity at the Stabilization Centre in Dikwa PHC from 15 to 25 beds and maintaining 73 beds at the Stabilization Centre in Maiduguri. Additional human resources and prepositioned nutrition supplies will support both sites. INTERSOS will deliver stabilization center and outpatient therapeutic program services, with LABDI supporting OTP delivery in both locations. Staff will be trained to manage severe acute malnutrition with and without complications in stabilization centers and community settings.nbspltbrgtPreventive nutrition interventions will reach caregivers and children through maternal, infant, and young child nutrition activities, family MUAC training, micronutrient distribution, supplementary feeding, and community-based support groups.nbspltspangtThe Maiduguri nutrition component for Standard Allocation 2,nbspwill supplementnbspStandard Allocation 1nbspby providing additional resources for the continuation and enhancement of services, while the scale-up of the Stabilization Centre in Dikwa ensures increased treatment capacity and improved access to quality care.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltbrgtHealth and nutrition services will be closely coordinated with WASH, FSL and protection interventions to ensure a multisectoral approach, inclusion, and accessibility for vulnerable populations. The project will also build the capacity of LABDInbsp asnbsplocal partner, contributing to localization efforts and enhancing sustainability.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtOverall, the project will reachnbsp42,726 individuals, including 59% female, 41% male, 55% children, and 6,410nbsppersons with disabilities. By combining health and nutrition interventions with prevention, treatment, and community engagement, the project aims to restore access to life-saving services and improve health and nutrition outcomes for affected communities in Dikwa and Maiduguri.lt/pgt
